rules.key: You may include 1 or more Warlord in your fleet
rules.text: You may include 1 or more Warlord in your fleet, each of whom must be assigned to a ship or squadron.
rules.why: Placement on a ship or a skwadron is decided in the game.

rules.key: worth 500 points or more it must include at least 1 Warlord
rules.text: If the fleet is worth 500 points or more it must include at least 1 Warlord to lead it.
rules.why: '500 or more' is at least, not over: a fleet of exactly 500 points already needs a Warlord.

rules.key: max of one Warlord per 500 points
rules.text: An Ork fleet can include a max. of one Warlord per 500 points.

rules.key: if the fleet is worth up to 500 points, it may have one Warlord
rules.text: ie, if the fleet is worth up to 500 points, it may have one Warlord. If it is worth 500-1,000 points two Warlords may be included, etc.
rules.why: The book's own example of the previous rule.

rules.key: Warlords get one re-roll
rules.text: Warlords get one re-roll.
rules.why: Shown as text of the commander section since 9.9.2026 (the sentence filter knows the words re-roll and leadership, P1-8e). The included re-roll is in the resolver's rerolls.included field and on the commander card; the fleet validator does not enforce the number of re-rolls.

rules.key: may include up to one of the upgrades shown below
rules.text: A vessel carrying a Warlord doubles its boarding value and may include up to one of the upgrades shown below at the additional cost indicated.
rules.why: The exclusion is implemented: five upgrades share the group id 'warlord_up', so choosing one switches the others off. Checked below in the entries block's grp field. The hull's doubled boarding value is left to the player.

rules.key: shield value is increased by
rules.text: The ship's shield value is increased by +1. If this would take it to 3 or more shields, don't forget to mount it on a 60 mm base!
rules.why: Nakyi 7.9.2026 asti tyhjana: lausesuodatin tunsi sanan 'reduced' muttei sanaa 'increased'.

rules.key: +1 modifier on boarding
rules.text: +1 modifier on boarding.
rules.why: The row's own description is kept visible (KEEP_TEXT) - it is the upgrade's effect, not narrative.

rules.key: up to one Ork Space Hulk in your fleet per 1,500 points
rules.text: You may include up to one Ork Space Hulk in your fleet per 1,500 points.
rules.why: The same rule is said twice in a row; the enforced version is the next sentence 'An Ork fleet can include a maximum of one space hulk per 1,500 points.'

rules.key: maximum of one space hulk per 1,500 points
rules.text: An Ork fleet can include a maximum of one space hulk per 1,500 points.

rules.key: Each Ork hulk must be assigned an Ork Warlord to command it
rules.text: Each Ork hulk must be assigned an Ork Warlord to command it.
rules.why: The app does not tie the Warlord to a single ship, so the requirement cannot be enforced.

rules.key: For every two kroozers included in your fleet, you may pick one vessel
rules.text: For every two kroozers included in your fleet, you may pick one vessel from the list below.

rules.key: You may include up to six kroozers in your fleet
rules.text: You may include up to six kroozers in your fleet.

rules.key: escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2
rules.text: You may include any number of escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2–6.

rules.key: You can include any number of Ork Roks in your fleet
rules.text: You can include any number of Ork Roks in your fleet.
rules.why: Limits nothing. Showed empty until 7.9.2026, because the sentence filter knew the words may/must but not the word 'can'.

rules.key: Ork Roks may also be purchased with points for planetary defences
rules.text: Ork Roks may also be purchased with points for planetary defences, in scenarios where these are used.

rules.key: squadroned with up to three other Roks
rules.text: Ork Roks may be squadroned with up to three other Roks (total squadron size of four), but not with any other vessels.
rules.why: Squadrons of hull ships are not in v1's model; Roks are added one by one. The book does not limit the total number.

rules.key: Ships with launch bays can have a mixture of fighta-bommerz
rules.text: Ships with launch bays can have a mixture of fighta-bommerz or assault boats.

rules.key: can replace their prow batteries with torpedo tubes at no extra cost
rules.text: Kill kroozers and Terror ships can replace their prow batteries with torpedo tubes at no extra cost.
rules.why: The same swap is a choice in the ship's own profile (p.382 and p.384), which the app handles: 'May replace its prow heavy gun battery with a torpedo launcha ... at no extra points cost.' The list sentence showed empty until 7.9.2026 because of the word 'can'.

rules.key: Ork capital ships can add +2 turrets to their ships for +20 points
rules.text: Ork capital ships can add +2 turrets to their ships for +20 points (this is not the same thing as saying “up to two turrets at +10 points each”).
rules.why: The book writes this only in the body text. The app offers it as the row 'Dakka Dakka: +2 turrets'.

rules.key: Ork escorts may add +1 turret for +5 points per escort
rules.text: Ork escorts may add +1 turret for +5 points per escort.
rules.why: As the row 'Dakka Dakka: +1 turret (every escort in the squadron)', the price multiplied by the skwadron's ships.

rules.key: every escort in a given squadron must take the refit
rules.text: If this option is taken, every escort in a given squadron must take the refit, not just individual escorts in a squadron.
rules.why: The row's price is per hull, so the whole skwadron pays it - but the requirement itself the player must remember.

rules.key: The Ork Clanz rules can be used in addition to the normal Ork rules
rules.text: The Ork Clanz rules can be used in addition to the normal Ork rules, but only with its dedicated Clanz fleet list.
rules.why: Says that the Clanz rules do not belong to this list; Clanz is a list of its own.

extra_entries.name: Dakka Dakka: +2 turrets
extra_entries.why: p.367/369 DAKKA DAKKA, the book writes it only in the body text

extra_entries.name: Dakka Dakka: +1 turret (every escort in the squadron)
extra_entries.why: the same section, price per escort

extra_entries.name: Torpedo-bommas
extra_entries.why: orkkien yhteiset saannot p.362, +10 per launch bay strength

extra_entries.name: Boarding torpedoes
extra_entries.why: orkkien yhteiset saannot p.362, +5 pts runkoalukselle

notes: In the book the four named battleships have '(0-1)' in front, and it is enforced as a per-row limit (mx=1). The Hammer class battlekroozer is the only one without a limit.

The battleship ratio's denominator is the KROOZERS section, not the whole fleet: 'For every two kroozers included in your fleet'. There may be at most six kroozers, so there can be at most three battleships.

The Ork Clanz block (pages 370-373) does NOT belong to this list, although in the book it is between this list and the Clanz list. The book's own sentence on page 370 says so directly. Until 7.9.2026 the app offered 14 Gubbins upgrades and six clan advantages here that may not be taken.
The list has no Lite kroozer row of its own: it is only in the Clanz list's 'Big ship skwadron' section.
